scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund (Direct Plan - Growth Option)
text:
[Scheme: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund (Direct Plan - Growth Option) | Topic: Statutory Lock-in Period]
HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund is an ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme) with a mandatory statutory lock-in period of 3 Years. Units cannot be redeemed, transferred, or switched before the completion of 3 years from the date of allotment.
citation_label: Groww - HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct-Growth

scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund (Direct Plan - Growth Option)
text:
[Scheme: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund (Direct Plan - Growth Option) | Topic: Fund Management & Overview]
HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund was launched on 01-Jan-2013 and is managed by Vinay Kulkarni. Objective: The scheme seeks to generate capital appreciation / income from a portfolio, comprising predominantly of equity & equity related instruments. Tax rules: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%. Stamp duty: 0.005% (from July 1st, 2020)%.
citation_label: Groww - HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct-Growth
